high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news feed from a mobile device. It features two individuals shaking hands in front of the flags of India and China. The person on the left appears to be Prime Minister Narendra Modi of India, dressed in traditional Indian attire, while the person on the right is President Xi Jinping of China, dressed in a formal suit. The top part of the image includes a logo for "Express Explained Global" and the text "The Indian Express," indicating the source of the article.
